blocks.text: Maple Ridge Open Houses: streets and boundaries

items.t: Signs for real estate in Maple Ridge are regulated by Maple Ridge Sign Bylaw No. 7620 – 2020, the bylaw named on the City's own sign permit application.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Open Houses: rules that affect buyers

items.t: A sign that needs a permit in Maple Ridge goes through the City's Sign Permit Application under Sign Bylaw No. 7620 – 2020, which asks for the sign type (including directional), the project address, the zone, and whether the sign is illuminated — an illuminated sign also needs an electrical permit application.

The City publishes set locations for development directional signs — location D1 is the corner of 201st Street and Lougheed Highway — so directional signage is placed at city-approved corners, not wherever a seller chooses.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Open Houses: local details a buyer would not know

items.t: Maple Ridge City Hall, which administers sign permits, is at 11995 Haney Place, Maple Ridge — the address printed on the City's sign permit and directional sign applications.

Sign permit drawings must be in metric: the City requires two sets of scaled drawings in metric for fascia, awning and projecting signs, including a site plan showing the sign against the parcel boundaries.
A directional sign permit holder must repair any municipal infrastructure affected by the sign work and return it to an equal or better condition within 24 hours, to the City's satisfaction.
Permit enquiries go to the City's Bylaw and Licencing Services Department, where sign plans and specifications are deposited and approved before the permit issues.
Maple Ridge property taxes are due the first business day in July (July 2 in 2026) — a possession date set just after an open-house purchase can land on the tax due date, which affects adjustments.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Open Houses: development and new projects

items.t: Named once here: the City's April 2, 2026 Housing Action Plan progress report (over 150 rezoning applications and 450 building permits underway; 751 net new homes delivered in the year to June 30, 2025). Status: City progress report (as of November 3, 2026).

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Open Houses: costs and taxes

items.t: The one sign-related dollar figure the City's own form states is the $500 cash-or-cheque deposit guaranteeing a temporary construction (directional) sign permit.
Maple Ridge is a designated taxable area for the provincial Speculation and Vacancy Tax — relevant to a buyer who purchases at an open house and leaves the home empty.
The City's 2026 property tax increase was set at 3.5%, and taxes are due the first business day in July.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Open Houses: getting around

items.t: Two West Coast Express stations sit inside Maple Ridge — Maple Meadows Station and Port Haney Station — on the Waterfront-to-Mission commuter line.
Route 791 (Haney Place to Braid Station) is the bus spine for cross-city open-house trips, running via Dewdney Trunk Road, Maple Meadows Way, Hammond Road and Harris Road through Pitt Meadows.
Lougheed Highway is the east-west road most directional signage points from — the City's first listed development directional sign location, D1, is at 201st Street and Lougheed Highway.

blocks.text: Maple Ridge Open Houses: risks and due diligence

items.t: A sign placed without the required permit can be cancelled by the City: the directional sign permit states it is subject to cancellation if the holder fails to observe Sign Bylaw No. 7620 – 2020.
Strata open houses carry strata rules: for a strata home, the Form B Information Certificate and the strata's bylaws, not the open-house feature sheet, state rental, pet and parking rules.

faq.q: Can my agent put directional signs anywhere to guide people to my Maple Ridge open house?
faq.a: No — directional signage is a regulated category here, not a free choice. Signs are governed by Maple Ridge Sign Bylaw No. 7620 – 2020, development directional signs go through the City's Temporary Construction Sign Application, and the City publishes approved sign locations such as the corner of 201st Street and Lougheed Highway.

faq.q: What does a directional sign permit cost the seller?
faq.a: The City's temporary construction sign permit requires a $500 deposit. The applicant deposits $500 in cash or cheque with the City to guarantee the permit's terms are fulfilled, and the permit can be cancelled if the holder does not comply with Sign Bylaw No. 7620 – 2020. That deposit is for development directional signage; a single-home open house may not need this permit class at all.

faq.q: How do I reach a Maple Ridge open house without a car?
faq.a: Use the West Coast Express or the 791 bus. Maple Ridge has two West Coast Express stations, Maple Meadows and Port Haney, and TransLink's route 791 runs from Haney Place through Maple Meadows Station and Pitt Meadows Station to Braid Station, connecting to the SkyTrain network. Check the current timetable before a weekend viewing.

faq.q: Does the City charge for a basic sign permit application?
faq.a: The application itself is filed with Bylaw and Licencing Services on the City's form. The form requires the contractor's current Maple Ridge trade licence number and two sets of scaled metric drawings for fascia, awning and projecting signs.

faq.q: Do I need my own agent to attend a Maple Ridge open house?
faq.a: No official source requires it. BCFSA's Real Estate Rules excuse disclosure of representation where a licensee is only hosting an advertised open house or answering general factual questions — but the moment you share your motivation, financial qualifications or needs, that changes, and BCFSA requires unrepresented consumers to be told the risks of dealing with a licensee who represents the other party.

faq.q: How do I know the open house time is current?
faq.a: Each listing on the page carries an OPEN HOUSE label with a date and start and end times, and the page states the feed updates every 15 minutes — check the page the day you plan to go.

faq.q: Which Maple Ridge areas can I cover in one trip?
faq.a: Group by the listing pools: East Central and West Central held the deepest inventory of both property types in September 2026 (82 detached / 120 attached and 66 detached / 78 attached respectively), with Albion, Cottonwood and Silver Valley as the eastern detached group — inventory counts only (SnapStats, September 2026)
